ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_logsumexp_tanh_max_abs_advantage_weighted_repaired
ir.intuition: Weighted margin ranking loss with tanh smoothing and log-sum-exp aggregation, emphasizing pairs with large weighted hinge losses using the maximum absolute advantage as a weight factor, fixed tensor ops for stability.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
adv_max = maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
weighted_hinge = hinge * abs(adv_max) * weight
max_val = max(weighted_hinge)
lse = log(sum(exp(weighted_hinge - max_val)) + eps)
batch_size = weighted_hinge.shape[0]
loss = lse + max_val - log(batch_size + eps)
return loss.mean()
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    adv_w = batch["advantage_w"]
    adv_l = batch["advantage_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("alpha", 1.0)))
    adv_max = ops.maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_max)
    weighted_hinge = ops.mul(hinge, weight_factor)
    weighted_hinge = ops.mul(weighted_hinge, weight)
    max_val = ops.max(weighted_hinge)
    lse_sum = ops.sum(ops.exp(ops.sub(weighted_hinge, max_val)))
    lse = ops.log(ops.clamp(lse_sum, min=eps))
    batch_size = weighted_hinge.shape[0] if weighted_hinge.shape[0] > 0 else 1
    batch_size_tensor = weighted_hinge.new_tensor(float(batch_size)).clamp(min=eps)
    loss = ops.sub(ops.add(lse, max_val), ops.log(batch_size_tensor))
    return loss.mean()
